name: Ice Breaker
source:
The player is searching for an item of their choosing: A fabled talisman said to belong to one of the many gods of this world, a lost tome that once belonged to a long-passed relative, or a mage who is supposed to have great prowess, enough so to cure this seemed curse of bad luck plaguing the player.

Not far into this journey, the player falls into peril and is rescued by a strange satyr who offers shelter from the mounting blizzard outside, and even some information on the player's item of choice.

[Edited from [url=https://nannicknodestudio.itch.io/icebreaker]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
玩家正在寻找他们选择的物品：一个传说中的护身符，据说属于这个世界的众多神灵之一，一本曾经属于一位早已去世的亲戚的失落的书，或者一个被认为拥有强大实力的法师，足以治愈困扰玩家的厄运诅咒。

在这段旅程中不久，玩家陷入危险并被一个奇怪的色狼所救，他为玩家提供了躲避外面愈演愈烈的暴风雪的庇护所，甚至还提供了一些关于玩家选择的物品的信息。

[编辑自[url=https://nannicknodestudio.itch.io/icebreaker]itch.io[/url]]
